title: TSD Daily — Tuesday, August 11, 2026
summary: A dashboard zero-day at CVSS 10.0 pulled customer data out of Framework, Tally and Kilo Code, Anthropic spent 36 hours buying power and a Riemann-zeta result, a 345-case salmonella outbreak hit five national grocers on date codes still in shelf life, and the money move is a fixed-fee data access audit you can sell this week.
